notes.title: Update 1.3 - Test Dummy Takedown
notes.content:
Hello, crash testers!

Version 1.3 is finally here with tons of improvements and new features to make your battles even more epic!

Bug Fixes
Various bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience.

Improved multiplayer stability.

Interface Overhaul
All menus have been completely redesigned for a more modern and intuitive look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/c5dd34af872604389be8c2223801f60ab07390fd.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/63a79a0eaab416a3a7da8254c04a430d106f4358.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/0e757d90faf814d12d4a235b227c5ecf8ef7a279.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/1faa500f316b82608f3318d4bc0e1401ca8856ab.png

Easier navigation to quickly access all options.

New Multiplayer Features
Steam Friend Invites: Easily invite your friends directly through Steam.

Friends Only Servers: Create private matches and battle only with your friends.




Thank you for your support and feedback! Keep sharing your thoughts so we can make Test Dummy Takedown even more fun and intense!

See you on the battlefield!
The Test Dummy Takedown Team

notes.title: Welcome to the Test Dummy Takedown Demo V1.0 – Get Ready for Chaos!
notes.content:
Welcome to the demo of Test Dummy Takedown. Here’s what’s included

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/5d04ead429d17700cc22f24a4ae5a8bc9eb5c593.png

Multiplayer Mayhem

2 to 8 players battle it out in arenas full of surprises.
Outsmart, outgun, and outlast your opponents to claim victory.


Demo Maps

Test your skills across three unique arenas:

Crash Factory – An industrial lab where dummies are put to the test.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4f64473c6c0569ce34f6e219b71dc54fa8911409.png

Gambling Ground – A chaotic casino where luck rules all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/92e58564675777358add52d8c84e564cd9edbf12.png

Coconut Chaos – A tropical beach where danger lurks beneath the sand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/e6f8873a0ff6c37c26de64bcd8e9fcfb6f8dcb59.png

Weapons & Lives

Start each match with a pistol loaded with 30 bullets.

Choose the number of lives (from 1 to 10) to customize the intensity of the fight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/2712b9197a782b51c8e58e4213c56701d331ca65.png

Power Customization

Pick 3 out of 15 special powers to suit your playstyle. Powers are divided into three categories:

Movement : Dash, Mega Jump, Super Speed, Spin, Fake Death.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4bc08d4e0c736fbb9d9b3db97ce71242f4834eae.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4cdf3ff23f90dc449fa167598b13df26323f02a2.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/e59662576f86f6c56e7ee65af208acf79acf4f3d.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/d3dc0bdb24d276c61029315f7ae0298de7684c94.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/ce6bf86e76d51e9f3132eca8d72bf32a51b6b01f.png

Ability : Dummy Boom, Invisibility, Invincibility, Heal, Fast Reload.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/48b41de6842634920ce7334931dd1ab352be97ee.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/da2d59fd2dc3376718a11ec98a7c12f65657f382.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/10dcc31c245f6a247796094b1ea77dedd6eb1699.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/25103c270d4e864acb482fbe31e8098777365215.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/219ca5f76fd30d1d0e5bfc03b726f256ab26dc71.png

Secondary Weapon : Grenade, Sniper, Knife Throw, Knife Strike, Golden Gun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/770a7f421738014c8dcbb55d6f1f80bbdd3a7ed3.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/6f914d4d5d22a8a25dcd3f6aef5bb5e0c7e4aeb9.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/802dc9f0cd597866709c9ba34de61bc29a2a62eb.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/35d9ed9db0e60db32f3478979f141011140149ee.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/d0812062cae46c690e32a1f5895fa7c8026f73aa.png

Dummy Customization

Stand out on the battlefield with a selection of accessories to personalize your dummy.

Choose from 10 accessories for your dummy, with more to come!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/f3451b62f8f3f1c62aa71efbb6760438437416c4.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/cdf000b0e167e96d30c4132ee7ced5d8586ddc3c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/bcd4095dfddff434bb9ca0af50f5a19d6afa0506.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/ab1ed52efe7f935633d43b6b9e3f1a90f3f32296.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/f6a383ad932c34295cb71e1768f78b0e099367f8.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/70f9b34460b5ecc9048f8dd5aa093763d8bc7a3b.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8a7e55ce8bcb5094214facce7d822d29f18906d6.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/e5412d1cad25e5a29bf10df47a2259806569bde0.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8dad52dcc1fc293937203b3270187000604e5466.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/0eaa29eda3996dfec6c2bf9c783f7f360fe883af.png

Choose the color of your dummy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/507ae1eee7033a2463ec58b24fecf14f8cd980e5.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8e64e776586e8ef67b0e9b2ed07d6480c3feafd3.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/ab7124032c533f5ac05bea1f2d6fefb28213c1d2.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/5a7e7968b8e5aa1e3ea789dfb7d60e00bf755b28.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/204d7d171b7d4fc5872c1b6e6326da35576c4084.png

Strategy & Survival

Manage your three powers wisely—use them at the right moment or remove them to save them for later.
The last dummy standing wins. Use every tool at your disposal to take down your opponents.


The Ultimate Party Battle

Test Dummy Takedown is the perfect game for chaotic, fun-filled nights with friends. Every match is different, filled with unpredictable moments and crazy plays.

Are you ready to take on the challenge? Jump in and let the chaos begin.
